title: VMD: update narrow-band modes and their center frequencies
summary: VMD alternates between frequency-domain mode updates and spectral-energy centers. DeTime's grouping into trend and season is a separate step after this optimization.

steps.title: Prepare the spectrum
steps.text: Mirror the signal, compute its FFT, and retain the positive-frequency representation.

steps.title: Update a mode
steps.text: Fit the remaining spectrum with a bandwidth penalty around the current center frequency.

steps.title: Update its center
steps.text: Use the mode's positive-frequency energy to update its center, then repeat across modes.

steps.title: Reconstruct and group
steps.text: Complete the conjugate spectrum, invert the FFT, crop the mirrored margins, and group modes.

parameters.name: K
parameters.effect: Number of modes; the demonstration uses 3.

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.effect: Penalizes spectral spread around each center; the demonstration uses 1500.

parameters.name: tau
parameters.effect: Dual-update step; zero permits noise slack and does not enforce an exact sum of modes.

parameters.name: init / tol
parameters.effect: Initialization and convergence tolerance affect the computed solution.

cautions: The animation captures the optional vmdpy path; the native path has its own implementation and iteration control.
Center frequencies shown here are raw solver frequencies in cycles/sample, not DeTime's converted metadata field.
VMD modes need a grouping rule before being named trend or season; frequency ordering is not a physical-source guarantee.
trace_note: Captured vmdpy 0.2 loop arrays without changing solver updates; intermediate time-domain modes use its conjugate-completion and mirror-cropping convention.
input_note: Deterministic synthetic teaching signal; not a benchmark.
